title: Refund charges billed after cancellation
summary: You cancelled and hold a confirmation, yet were billed — demand a refund, escalate to chargeback with proof.
goal_default: Please refund all charges applied after my cancellation date and confirm in writing.

rights.claim: With a cancellation confirmation, card issuers routinely issue chargebacks for continued billing.
rights.basis: Card-scheme chargeback rules for cancelled recurring services.

rights.claim: Reference your confirmation number and cancellation date explicitly to speed the reversal.

ladder: Refund demand with the cancellation confirmation attached

artifact.subject: Refund — charged after a confirmed cancellation{{account_suffix}}

disclaimer: This is information to help you write your own request. It is not legal advice and guarantees no outcome.
